title: Willis S NDE 427
content: Started with intense pain, worst of my life. The pain was suddenly gone. I found myself in a dark void. No light. Slowly in the center of the void, I became aware of a change in color. The darkness had a pinpoint of grey. The grey slowly became white. This white spot began to grow. It was as if this white area was 3D. It was rising out of the void coming directly towards me. I saw it as either a volcano, or a pimple, no other way to put it. It was not a tunnel. The white area continued to rise toward me. I got the impression that the white area was swelling from internal pressure. As it came closer, I felt that I could almost touch it. The most important thing was the feeling that the internal pressure was reaching a bursting point. Somehow, I knew that if the white area burst all of the void would be replaced with an intense, warm, bright light. I also knew that if it burst, I was gone. I did my best to will it not to burst. I was not ready for that. Suddenly it was all gone, I was back in the catheterization lab and they were working on me, but the pain was gone.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes Heart attack Life threatening event, but not clinical death Heart attack.
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: Uncertain I was not aware of a body, only the void and the light.
elements.At what time during the experience were: I felt very alert but I could not have been.
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning The event seemed like it lasted a very long time. But it must have been over in seconds.
elements.The experience included: Void | Darkness | Light | Strong emotional tone
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will I had to keep the light from bursting. I did not want it to, I did not fear it, but I was not ready for it.
elements.God, Spiritual and Religion: point of no return? I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will I had to keep the light from bursting. I did not want it to, I did not fear it, but I was not ready for it. God, Spiritual and Religion
elements.Did you have a change in your values and: Uncertain I don't know what to believe.
elements.After the NDE: change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? Uncertain I don't know what to believe. After the NDE
elements.Was the experience difficult to express: Yes It was a visual/emotional experience, hard to share.
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: Best? That it ended. Worst? Nothing comes to mind.
elements.Have you ever shared this experience wit: Yes Only my wife. She keeps questioning me about it, but I am having trouble explaining it.
